items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Then, jumps around and played with Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I knew his brother Mutt, but I never knew Jack Carrey.
Well, Mutt, I know Mutt, too. Well, I started playing with Jack. I played with Jack a very long time. Then, jumps around and played with Chris Kelly.
Can you tell us who else was in the band when you played with Jack Carrey?

items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: Chris did have bad shoes... Chris was a man that's not like to drink... I wouldn't play with Chris, man.

ctx.x: Broken shoes. Oh, I wouldn't say that. No, I wouldn't. No, I wouldn't do that. No, I wouldn't do that.

Chris did have bad shoes. With that question, Doc, he sure did. Because when Faye saw that time, him and Black Banner had that humbug about tuxedo suits and all that. Chris was a man that's not like to drink, you know. He was a good blues man and didn't wear too much fancy clothes, you know. No, no. That's why we tell the people the truth.
But now, Celestan and Pirone's band, you played with them. Yeah, them guys were uniform. What were they dressed like?
